subject: Actual SsmExplorerVisual, indexed model, viewport culling and segmented data store

fixture.dependencies: Four backward references within each 200-equipment neighborhood, plus explicit cross-project references every 2500 equipment
fixture.metadata: Owner, model-formatted numeric progress, typed calendar date, notes and separate milestone/parent metadata
fixture.privacy: Synthetic only; no private registries or workbooks

segmented100k.operationKind: Create=0 followed by delta Segment=2 without overlap

productionBundle.source: Generated .tmp/drop/visual.js and visual.css, not a TypeScript source import

verified: Default startup renders only L1/L2 milestones; equipment opens on milestone or parent click
All three cold cases retain exact loaded equipment totals and distinct project-scoped identities
Live node DOM stays within its 300-node default cap through expansion, search, selection and pan
Dense 1000-child hub connection lists are paged rather than rendering every connection
Search reaches the last Delta record and native report selection uses its actual supplied row identity
Fixed drawer bounds remain unchanged during 20 canvas pan operations
Delta segments and cumulative append preserve original identities and compatible selection
Selected label, discipline/type and tag remain readable under hostile inherited text CSS in light, dark and high contrast
Relationship legend lines are 25px wide and 2px thick, with 12px labels
limitations: A 100k-row monolithic snapshot blocks synchronous ingestion for approximately 1.5 seconds on this machine; an earlier observation reached 1.7 seconds
The segmented audit yielded between 2000-row windows, but a single update still reached 207ms and total ingestion took 4.46 seconds
Search timings include the intentional 120ms debounce; pan timings measure handler work rather than full frame paint
Measurements are representative observations rather than universal timing guarantees or statistics over repeated runs
Overview culling can hide off-screen milestone columns; benchmarks expand a visible milestone rather than assuming Alpha is on screen
Browser host mocks do not verify Power BI report filtering, drillthrough, row-level security, persisted host formatting or real data-delivery latency
Audit data, synthetic benchmark scripts and local screenshots are excluded from distributed pbiviz packages
